entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: The aging wizard and governor of Bryce who summons sand warriors and a sandstorm against Johan.

entities.name: Jaeger
entities.description: A tiger man found in the Sukurvian Desert, an extraordinary warrior who is the None of the prophecy and is devoured by a sandworm.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: The tyrant of Tirras who leads an invasion of Bryce and Palmyra and is the One of the prophecy.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Hazezon's ex-wife, ruler of Palmyra and leader of the Robaran Mercenaries.

entities.name: Robaran Mercenaries
entities.description: Mercenaries led by Adira who raid ships to finance the war.

entities.name: Xira Arien the Glass Mountain
entities.description: A Tirran mage who summons Stone-Throwing devils.

entities.name: Beckoner
entities.description: The shaman of the merfolk tribe Born of the Beck who makes a pact with Hazezon and reverses the River Toloron.

entities.name: Merfolk of the Sunken Sea
entities.description: Merfolk who kidnapped Palmyrans because the dam disrupted fish.

entities.name: Bryce
entities.description: The city governed by Hazezon, attacked by Tirras.

entities.name: Palmyra
entities.description: A neutral city-state near the River Toloron ruled by Adira that is fortified with a dam.

entities.name: Tirras
entities.description: The mountain city ruled by Johan.

entities.name: Sukurvian Desert
entities.description: The desert where Hazezon finds the tiger man.

entities.name: Sunken Sea
entities.description: An underground sea beneath the desert where the merfolk live.

entities.name: River Toloron
entities.description: The river along which Johan's army travels, reversed and dried by Beckoner's magic.

entities.name: Princess Lucrezia
entities.description: A ruler at war with the sha of Fysmatan.

entities.name: Fysmatan
entities.description: The power that buys the captured warships.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent Johan believes he is destined to rule.

events.summary: Hazezon finds the tiger man in the Sukurvian Desert and brings him toward Bryce, learning of the prophecy of None, One, and Two.
events.quote: when None and One clash, only Two shall remain.

events.summary: Tirras attacks Bryce; Jaeger saves Hazezon and leads the militia in repelling the invaders despite stone-throwing devils.
events.quote: led by him, the militia of Bryce repels the invaders, albeit at great cost.

events.summary: Nightstalkers sent by Johan ambush Hazezon and Adira, changing Adira's mind to help Bryce.
events.quote: The ambush fails, but this changes Adira's mind and she decides that Palmyra will help Bryce.

events.summary: The Robarans overthrow Lucrezian marines on a secret island with the enslaved islanders and sell the warships to Fysmatan.
events.quote: together, the two forces overthrow the marines, capturing the warships and selling them to Fysmatan for a great sum.

events.summary: Hazezon seals a pact with Beckoner, ending the merfolk attacks on Palmyra.
events.quote: Hazezon can seal a pact with Beckoner, shaman of the tribe Born of the Beck.

events.summary: Johan boils the merfolk and destroys Palmyra's dam with an earthquake.
events.quote: Johan summons an earthquake that destroys the dam, freeing the river road down to Bryce.

events.summary: Beckoner reverses the River Toloron and dries it, forcing Johan's army to return north.
events.quote: Without means to transport supplies, Johan's army cannot reach Bryce by land and is forced to return north.

events.summary: Hazezon summons sand warriors and a huge sandstorm as Tirrans besiege Palmyra.
events.quote: the real magic summoned by Hazezon is a huge sandstorm

events.summary: The sandstorm destroys Johan's army; Jaeger reveals he is the None and fights Johan, who is devoured by a sandworm.
events.quote: While the two are fighting, a sandworm leaps out and devours Jaeger.

events.summary: Jaeger's last words reveal other tiger men in the east, and Johan plans to make them part of his army.
events.quote: intends to make them part of his new army.

relations.quote: a mountain city ruled by the tyrant Johan

relations.note: Wages war on Bryce and Palmyra.
relations.quote: Understanding that this attack wasn't a simple raid, but a declaration of war

relations.note: Seals a pact with the shaman.
relations.quote: Hazezon can seal a pact with Beckoner

relations.note: Rescues him and fights beside him.
relations.quote: the tiger man - Jaeger - comes to his rescue.
